sentences.text:
This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.603/2023 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - G.R.P, District - Ujjain for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N), 323, 506 of IPC and Section 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
2.

As per prosecution case, it is alleged that on 20/11/2023 when the prosecutrix was travelling alongwith the family, at railway station Shujalpur she got off the train under the pretext of going to washroom and thereafter she did not come back.
A missing report was lodged and thereafter the prosecutrix was recovered after 11 days.

It is alleged that the prosecturix was enticed by the applicant on the promise of marriage and made physical relationship with him.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C she has stated that she has willingly made physical relationship with the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the facts of the case that the incident had taken place on 19/11/2023 and the prosecutrix was recovered on 30/11/2023.
She remained for 11 days with the applicant and did not raise any alarm at any stage.
The age of the prosecturix is 17 years 5 months 3 days which is nearing 18 years of age, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

6. It is directed that applicant Karan Aathiya shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.
Cc as per rules.
